name: VJ Save Restricted Content
description: A Telegram bot to save and upload restricted content. Deployable on Heroku.

ADMINS.description: Your Telegram user ID (for admin access)

CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel ID where the bot uploads files (optional)

DB_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI (required for data storage)

LOGIN_SYSTEM.description: Set to True to enable login system, False to disable

STRING_SESSION.description: Fill only if LOGIN_SYSTEM is False (Pyrogram session string)

WAITING_TIME.description: Time in seconds to wait between actions (default: 10)

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Set to True to receive error messages in PM
